summary_1line: Bhishma outlines moral restraints and introduces a discourse on Shiva’s greatness as Krishna recounts seeking Mahadeva through penance at a Himalayan hermitage.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna arrives at a serene Himalayan hermitage where tigers and deer wander peacefully among ascetics beneath flowering trees beside the Ganga.
The sage Upamanyu with matted locks and ragged robes greets Krishna in the forest retreat, surrounded by disciples and sacred fires.
Ascetics in the mountain ashram practice extreme vows—some living on air, some on smoke, others meditating beside piles of ash and sacred fires.
